audit_evidence.reason: annotation and prediction geometry is restricted to the runner

diagnostics.reason: submitted-system stderr and collector diagnostics are restricted to the runner

evidence: Acquisition and coverage were calculated from fresh deterministic matches.
interpretation.statement: The system missed a substantial portion of eligible target observations.

possible_causes: Localization or class output may fail matching gates.

leaderboard.comparison_rule: Compare only identical benchmark fingerprints and class IDs. A result Pareto-dominates another only when it is no worse on every declared raw axis and strictly better on at least one; raw accuracy and efficiency axes are always retained.

limitations: GPU/VRAM metrics are omitted unless a future runner assigns an isolated device.
Version 1 evidence overlays use synthetic source frames and MP4V when the local codec is available.
Statistical comparison confidence is sample-count based; confidence intervals are not inferred.
Portable Unix sockets do not expose queue depth; sender pressure and delivery backlog are reported instead.

provenance.bounded_audit_evidence_hash_algorithm: sha256(cvbench.canonical-json/v1); authoritative after Worker JSON parsing

evaluation_order.public_calibration_note: Scenario manifests and calibration clips are public and recognizable; this ordering and the run-scoped sequence IDs do not provide secrecy.

redaction.reason: restricted audit geometry, diagnostics, and host paths removed for CI publication

gpu_accounting.note: No isolated GPU device was assigned; host-wide GPU data is not reported.

clocks.completion: external collector and runner monotonic time
clocks.delivery: independent monotonic replay schedule; successful frame-send completion is the online scoring origin
clocks.source: immutable native scenario time; source_timestamp_ns is the causal frame identity and is not the online latency origin

delivery.input_queue_depth_note: Unix stream queue depth is not portable; sender pressure and schedule backlog are the authoritative transport-pressure evidence.
delivery.semantics: ordered lossless delivery; slow readers do not move the source clock

output.late_output_policy: accepted through the bounded drain window only for exact already-delivered source timestamps; retained latency remains externally measured
